## Expression on this line

The Gender Studies line at orange Stage 11 is **gender as an attribute of the autonomous
individual under formally-equivalent universal rights**. The transition is from amber's
gender-as-ascribed-kin-role for an in-group to orange's gender-as-statutorily-equivalent-
attribute of an individual-statute-standing in a public-domain subordinated to rights-equal-
procedure. The orange stage is the achievement of *the individual* as the unit of gender-
standing — formally-equivalent across men, women, and other-gendered persons in the eyes of
the state and the major public-domain institutions.

The structural changes are:

- **Statute-of-equality-and-anti-discrimination.** A statute-that-makes-discrimination-by-
  gender actionable; with arms-length-statutory-independent-discipline, statutory-track-and-audit
  and remedially-applicable.
- **Statutory-employment-equivalence.** A statutory-of-equivalent-pay-for-equivalent-work
  applied across occupations with cross-occupation statutory-equivalence-statute discipline.
- **Statutory-marital-and-custody-equity-architecture.** Statutory-marital-and-custody-
  architecture operative with rights-equal-procedure-discipline.
- **Statutory-public-leadership-and-discipline.** Statutory-discipline-foundational-public-
  leadership-discipline-modes-track-statute-operate.
- **Statute-of-cross-jurisdiction-cooperation-active.** Active cross-jurisdiction-cooperation-
  cohort (CEDAW-style international-statute-equality-gen, etc.).
- **Statutory-individual-rights-discipline-effective.** Individual-statutory-rights-discipline-
  effective; statutory-equality-discipline-effective out-of-statute-as-published.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from orange-11)

- **UL:** the practitioner's *vocation-of-equivalence-discipline-from-political-press*: the
  craftsman-statute-of-gender-discipline-of-substantive-discipline-of-statute-equivalence.
- **UR:** independent-statutory-equality-and-anti-discrimination statute, statutory-employment-
  equivalence, statutory-marital-and-custody-equity, statutory-public-leadership-and-discipline.
- **LL:** *civic-faith-in-statutory-of-equivalence*: a polity that recognizes gender-as-a-public-
  domain bound by rights-equal-procedure.
- **LR:** statute-of-equality-and-anti-discrimination, statutory-employment-equivalence,
  statutory-marital-and-custody-equity, statutory-public-leadership-discipline, cross-jurisdiction
  cooperation-cohort-statute-equity-gen.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to orange-11):** **statutory-formalism-and-statutory-correction-
  -without-substance** — over-reliance on a formal-statutory-equivalence-recourse and
  remedially-effective discipline takes its place as stake-substitute for actual operating-
  discipline-of-equivalence; formal-recourse displacing actual-of-statute-of-equivalence
  effective without consistent case-finding.
- **Dark allergy (orange-11 foundation skipped/fragile):** statutory-equity and anti-
  discrimination statute-on-the-statute-book with operating-statutory-equivalent low or
  statutory-effective-cap-lowered-with-public-press; recurrent-statutory-equivalent-shift-with-
  publication-of-recurrent-statute-tabs.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Green prematurely):** **multi-stakeholder-statutory-equity-
  network** as substitute for gender-as-a-public-domain bound by rights-equal-procedure;
  multi-stakeholder-objects-substituting-statute-discipline.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing orange-11):** nativist-refusal to the worldcentric turn of
  considering-gender-as-a-public-domain; "our tradition, our family discipline"; refusing-
  statutory-equivalent-as-discipline.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signal *types* that place a gender-system holon at **orange Stage 11**. State the
signal as a class; the specific real-world instance lives in the Entity holon that cites this cell.

- **Statute-of-equality-and-anti-discrimination-applied-functional.** A pattern-of-statutory-
  applied-to-equality-of-discrimination claims-by-gender with remedy-ratchet-statistical;
  applied-statute-of-equality-of-equivalent-pay-for-equivalent-work-case-trend rankings.
- **Statutory-employment-equivalence-operational.** Statutory-equivalent-pay-statute-or-comparable
  applied operational-statutory-effective-track-record; statutory-equivalence-by-occupation
  cross-effective.
- **Statutory-marital-and-custody-equity-architecture-operational.** Statutory-marital-statute
  with arms-length-equity-statute discipline applied; statutory-custody-statute effective.
- **Statutory-public-leadership-and-discipline-operational.** Statutory-discipline-of-public-
  leadership-and-discipline-and-of of discipline-of-statute-and-of-discipline-statutory.
- **Cross-jurisdiction-cooperation-cohort-statute-active-functional.** Active-participation-in-
  international-statutory-equity-gen-cohort; cross-jurisdiction-cooperation-statistical-effective-
  discipline.
- **Statutory-equality-discipline-effective-trends-trending-up.** Trends-stats-by-statute-of-
  effective-equality-discipline-trending-statistical across cycles, with decreasing-statutory-
  effective discipline.
